advisories.title: DialogHandler cryptographic weakness
advisories.detail: Builds before 2017.2.621. Confirm the key in use separately.

advisories.title: RadAsyncUpload deserialization
advisories.detail: Through 2019.3.1023. 2020.1.114 blocks the default path. Known encryption material changes the picture.

advisories.title: RadAsyncUpload cryptographic chain
advisories.detail: Through 2026.2.519. Fixed in 2026.2.708. Requires a non-default encryption key.

advisories.title: Image editor file read
advisories.detail: 2011.2.712 through 2026.2.708 inclusive. Fixed in 2026.3.812. Requires a static machineKey or dialog key.
